independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier, session 67eca439-bf25-440d-8359-2150c9185d69, task T-DG7-REV-QA-R7. At the start I checked the assignment's sha256 (0d78f1d2ff93e3ae40224bb3c9195642729209b46bfb65d5ef8f8b3afc656958). In this run I wrote no product implementation, no test in the candidate, no register row, ADR, handover text, repair or delivery decision, and I changed no candidate file. My drivers and probes ran in disposable sparse shared clones of 7579382c under $TMPDIR, on disposable PostgreSQL clusters; the clones were removed at the end. Their scripts are kept as evidence outside the candidate. The implementer roles listed wrote the product, tools, guides and register, and the round-7 disclosure repair (AN-P7I text, DO-D10 handover texts and the release-notes generator change). The orchestrator decided D-280, froze the candidate and allow-listed the two history entries. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-7 record, and I have not read them. Their run commits (dd1bdbf01 code-security, cf01e0486 domain) appeared during my run. I listed only their subjects, and they change no candidate file: the candidate id recomputes unchanged at the end. The round-6 qa-verifier files I read are my own role's earlier run.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate at the start and at the end. Check HEAD and the commits since the source commit. Recompute the candidate id in the repository tree and in a clone at the source commit. Run --diff against the round-7 manifest.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git log 7579382c..HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --diff; (clone) git checkout 7579382c5 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7; again at the end
checks_run.environment: Repository tree (HEAD 9bb110e43, the round-7 freeze commit, at the start; cf01e0486 at the end); sparse shared clone at 7579382c under $TMPDIR; Node 24.21.0 (first on PATH).
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:0d71d445...2272, 3158 files, in the tree and in the clone. --diff matches. HEAD differs from the source only by the freeze commit's delivery records.
checks_run.actual: Start: HEAD is 9bb110e43 'DG7: freeze round 7 on sha256:0d71d445; assignments'. Its only changes from 7579382c are the three round-7 assignments, the manifest and stages.json. The tree recomputes sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272 (3158 files). --diff matches with no added, removed or changed files. The clone at 7579382c recomputes the same id. I computed it before linking the per-package node_modules shims, which git would otherwise see as untracked symlinks. In the clone, --diff exits 1 by design. It takes no path: it compares with the manifest named by the tree's stages.json, and at 7579382c, before the freeze commit, that is still the round-6 manifest. So it lists the round-7 change set, as the log explains. End (20:42Z): HEAD is cf01e0486, after two run-agent auto-commits (code-security dd1bdbf01, domain cf01e0486; I read only their subjects). The id is unchanged and --diff matches. The clone had no tracked modification. The assignment names docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-7/qa-verifier.json as the template; it does not exist (DG5 has rounds 1-5). I mirrored the schema and my DG7 round-6 record.

checks_run.expected: Every file passes, or a failure is explained and shown to be outside the candidate; skips explained.
checks_run.actual: First run: 472 of 475 files; 4691 passed, 5 failed, 8 skipped, 1 todo; exit 1 (3983 s). The 5 failures are contract.test.ts and response-validation.test.ts (each 'P5 BE-M operations' and 'covers every operation', the latter listing cancelExport) and exports.test.ts 'a renderer's own validation error fails the job at once with export.render_failed'. Cause: my environment. My per-package node_modules shim linked @mth/* to the repository's own workspace links, which resolve to /home/user/My-owns/packages/*. The stack shows renderPdf at ../home/user/My-owns/packages/reporting. The tests import RenderError by relative path from the clone (exports.test.ts l.16), while export-runner.ts imports it via @mth/reporting. That gives two module instances, so 'instanceof RenderError' (export-runner.ts l.462) is false. After I made each @mth link resolve inside the clone, the three files passed 246/246, exit 0. So the candidate has no failing integration test. Skips are the same as in round 6: a18-transfer-drill.test.ts skips 7 by design, because the drill inputs are absent in this run ('BLOCKED: ... skipped, not passed'); my input-driven harness run passed 10/10 (QA-R7-11). presentation.test.ts skips 1 of a mutually exclusive it.runIf pair. The todo is audit-events.test.ts 'PENDING T-DG6-BE-B', carried from the approved DG6. Included and passing: a06-bundle-replay.test.ts (28; REQ-S19-008 replay into a clean installation), a19-backup-restore-drill.test.ts (13), p7-transfer-guards.test.ts (22) and scale-scope-business-units.test.ts (4; the A26 regression). checks_run.actual: Baseline: '0 unfinished item(s), 23 later clause(s); ... up to date', exit 0. Removing EN en[3] gives exit 1 ('out of date'). Removing AR ar[2] gives exit 1. An empty list gives exit 1. An unknown key x gives exit 2 ('BLOCKED: ... unknown key x'). A missing file gives exit 2 ('BLOCKED: ... not found'). Restored: exit 0.
